aim: Resolve JGPS M31 simulated reviewers' question: identify a source-compatible, representation-mediated warrant-promotion error beyond mere missing map provenance, without overclaiming an independent confirmation axiom.

promotion_failure.source_claim: Scientific/task adequacy of representation R and valid observed match E_R for task T.
promotion_failure.unsupported_step: E_R is credited as positive evidence for capacity-type identity H_C solely because R validly represents/predicts T.
promotion_failure.missing_warrant: Contrastive justification of E_R against the live same-Q,C identity alternatives plus a capacity-relevant bridge.
not_claimed: loss of known x support merely because y is possible
published scientists committed this exact error
empirical validation of H-indexed pair law

distinctions.D_U: One coarse match event E under different auxiliary background assumptions; marginalize model hypotheses only with warranted weights conditional on identity alternatives.
distinctions.x_y: Two different, specified event generators and a map reporting/selection policy; numeric mixture coincidence does not equate epistemic situations.
distinctions.partial_knowledge: No universal numeric threshold for unknown scientific models: classify QUALIFIED, UNDERQUALIFIED, ACTIVATED_UNDERCUTTING with evidence and epistemic assumptions spelled out.

patterson_gainotti_fixed_question.question: Whether a represented task-level match for two candidate systems supports their having the same mechanistically individuated semantic-generalization capacity.
patterson_gainotti_fixed_question.criterion: Mechanistic dependence on common convergence versus distributed task-gated routes, explicitly author-stipulated and ontologically contestable.
patterson_gainotti_fixed_question.source_scientific_controversy: Distributed-only vs plus-hub architectures and clinical constraints, NOT documented empirical pairwise capacity-type identity.
patterson_gainotti_fixed_question.source_inference_boundary: Reviewed generalized cross-modal deficits and ATL pathology can constrain causal models; clinical data do not supply a fixed-pair identity Bayes factor or activated undercutter.

prior_art_position: A specialized event-construction and warrant-transfer audit already achievable by complete standard contrastive confirmation; does not claim to correct Beni, North, or Brousalis.

reproducibility.current_branch_receipt: exact HEAD to be recorded in PR and Issue on successful CI
